That should be fine. But they said parsing error due to missing action? Maybe they expect no <action> tags if final answer. Our format matches. Maybe they require no extra spaces? Should be fine. However maybe they expect also to validate with measurements? Might be they want to ensure topology matches measurements. Our guess may be wrong. Could try to validate using tool validate_measurements to see error. Let's attempt to validate.
